Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear asks. I’ve sketched three practical paths and attached a worked proposal and pricing model for each. TL;DR: we can lock today’s rates for 12 or 24 months with a stepped discount schedule and a staged prepay that supports your ramp.

Options (summary):
- Annual prepay (12m): 10% discount off list with monthly usage credit. Upfront invoice, renewable. Good if you expect steady usage.
- Multi-year (24m) prepay: 16% effective discount if you prepay full year one+commit to year two; option to spread payment into 3 invoiced milestones (40/30/30). Includes a 10% overage credit pool.
- Staged prepay (recommended for onboarding teams): Commit to annual minimum N tokens; prepay 50% initially, 30% at 6 months, 20% at 12 months. Locks price for 24 months on committed volume; additional usage billed at agreed T&M unit rate.

Key notes:
- Ramp protection: if you exceed committed volume by >20% in any quarter, we apply overage at the committed unit price (not list).
- Price protection: locking requires a signed order form; we can add a clause to limit price increases for comparable model classes.
- Approval: discounts above 18% need Sales Ops approval (looping Rafael).

I attached: GF-MA-Proposal-v3.pdf (proposal with schedules) and redwood-pricing-model.xlsx (breakouts).

If you’d like, we can put together a 3-row AM presentation for Finance next Monday.

Best,
